name: serializeAISession
description: Converts an AI session to a JSON string with its settings and conversation history, so it can be stored and restored later with `loadAISession()`.

params.name: maxlength
params.description: The maximum number of recent exchanges to keep. Older ones are left out.

params.name: condense
params.description: When true, older parts of the conversation are summarized to save space.
